title: The Wallace problem and countably compact torsion-free Abelian groups in ZFC
summary: We prove in ZFC that every torsion-free Abelian group of cardinality $\mathfrak c$ admits a Hausdorff countably compact group topology without nontrivial convergent sequences. In particular, this applies to the free Abelian group $\mathbb{Z}^{(\mathfrak c)}$, the Baer-Specker group $\mathbb{Z}^ω$ and $\mathbb{Q}^{(\mathfrak c)}$. For the topology constructed on $\mathbb{Z}^{(\mathfrak c)}$, the coordinatewise nonnegative cone is countably compact in the subspace topology.
